Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 1 - Introduction to Telephony on the Macintosh / Telephone Manager Initialization Reference
Constants

Handle Types

These constants define the handle types for the handleType field in the feature list structure (page 1-28). 
enum {
   telHandleType           = 0,
   telDNHandleType         = 1,
   telCAHandleType         = 2
};
Constant descriptions
telHandleType
A handle to a telephone record.
telDNHandleType
A handle to a directory number record.
telCAHandleType
A handle to a call appearance record.
